description: Fill in any subset of a listing, draft or live. Send only the fields you want to change; null clears an optional field. On a live listing most fields publish at once, and a changed name, playUrl, descriptionMarkdown or nsfw goes through the same review as the dashboard form (the result says review: applied or queued). You cannot submit a listing. When the draft is filled in, give the person the dashboardUrl so they can check it and press Submit.

contactEmail.description: Email address for the site to reach the owner

descriptionMarkdown.description: Markdown, at least 150 characters of text

genres.description: Names, slugs or ids from list_taxonomy. A name the site lacks becomes a suggestion.

launchStatus.description: in_development, alpha, beta, early_access, live or sunset

links.description: Network to URL, for example { "youtube": "https://youtube.com/@x" }. null removes one.

platforms.description: Names, slugs or ids from list_taxonomy. A name the site lacks becomes a suggestion.

playUrl.description: https URL where people play or download the game

playerModes.description: Names, slugs or ids from list_taxonomy. A name the site lacks becomes a suggestion.

themes.description: Names, slugs or ids from list_taxonomy. A name the site lacks becomes a suggestion.

name: update_listing
